d: Fixing a small problem early prevents a bigger one later.
p: a stitch in time saves nine

d: What people do is more important than what they say.
It is better to arrive or do something late than not at all.
A job is easier when many people help.
Those who start early have the best chance of success.
p: the early bird catches the worm

d: Follow the customs of the place you are visiting.
p: when in Rome, do as the Romans do
